system.description:
Wit; 3 Pierce; Long (150 ft). Pinned: a Large or smaller enemy it hits can't Move until it spends its Interact Action pulling the stake out, taking 1 wound. Vampire Slayer: after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, roll a CR 2 Luck Check; on a success it dies outright.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.145
system.summary: Wit; 3 Pierce; Long (150 ft). Pinned: a Large or smaller enemy it hits can't Move until it spends its Interact Action pulling the stake out, taking 1 wound. Vampire Slayer: after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, roll a CR 2 Luck Check; on a success it dies outright.

automation.note: Pinned: the target is Immobile until it spends its Interact Action removing the projectile, which gives it 1 wound. Only Large or smaller enemies are pinned, so remove Immobile from anything bigger.
Vampire Slayer: if this was a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, keep it targeted, post this weapon to chat and roll its CR 2 Luck Check. On a success the enemy is slain instantly.

automation.label: Vampire Slayer (after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower)
automation.onSuccess: The targeted enemy is slain instantly.
